news.title: Medical College of Wisconsin Dedicates Michels Center for Cancer Discovery Following Landmark Gift
news.summary_en: The Medical College of Wisconsin (MCW) celebrated the dedication and official unveiling of the exterior signage for the Michels Center for Cancer Discovery, honoring Tim and Barbara Michels and the Michels Family Foundation for the transformational $27 million gift announced by MCW in June 2026 to...
